author: Universe Scales
note: A schematic rotating neutron star with a tilted magnetic axis and two emission-beam guides. The star, magnetic-axis guides and beams turn together; the neutral reference circle stays fixed. Colors, beam width, tilt and field loops are illustrative, not observations of these objects. Beams depict directions of radiation, not rigid matter; pulse visibility depends on the observer. This is not a relativistic magnetosphere simulation.
